1	package musecode

15		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
16	)

18	// Package-level variables for mocking in tests
19	var (
20		osUserHomeDir = os.UserHomeDir
21		osGetwd       = os.Getwd
22	)
23	
24	const (
25		// sessionFileName is the transcript inside every session directory.
26		sessionFileName = "session.jsonl"
27	
28		// subagentDirName holds one transcript per spawned subagent. Those are not
29		// independent sessions and must never be enumerated as such.
30		subagentDirName = "subagent"
31	
32		// maxHeaderBytes bounds how much of a transcript is read to find its
33		// workspace root. The metadata record is written at session open and is
34		// always the first line, so a small prefix answers the question without
35		// touching multi-megabyte transcripts.
36		maxHeaderBytes = 256 * 1024
37	)
38	
39	// museSessionFile is a discovered transcript plus the header fields needed to
40	// decide which project it belongs to, without parsing the whole file.
41	type museSessionFile struct {
42		Path          string
43		SessionID     string
44		WorkspaceRoot string
45	}
46	
47	// GetMuseSessionsDir returns the root of Muse Code's session store. Muse is an
48	// XDG-conformant application, so XDG_DATA_HOME wins when set and the store
49	// otherwise lives at ~/.local/share/muse/sessions.
50	func GetMuseSessionsDir() (string, error) {
51		if dataHome := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME")); dataHome != "" {
52			return filepath.Join(dataHome, "muse", "sessions"), nil
53		}
54	
55		homeDir, err := osUserHomeDir()
56		if err != nil {
57			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %w", err)
58		}
59		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".local", "share", "muse", "sessions"), nil
60	}
61	
62	// defaultProjectPath fills in an empty project path with the current working
63	// directory. Provider entry points call this once so the same resolved path is
64	// used both for matching sessions to the project and as the workspace root
65	// stamped into generated session data (stamping the raw empty string would fail
66	// schema validation and break path hint normalization).
67	func defaultProjectPath(projectPath string) (string, error) {
68		if projectPath != "" {
69			return projectPath, nil
70		}
71		cwd, err := osGetwd()
72		if err != nil {
73			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get current working directory: %w", err)
74		}
75		return cwd, nil
76	}
77	
78	// walkMuseSessionFiles calls visit for every top-level session transcript under
79	// the date-sharded store. Subagent directories are pruned outright: they hold
80	// full transcripts in the same format, so enumerating them would invent
81	// sessions the user never started.
82	func walkMuseSessionFiles(sessionsRoot string, visit func(path string)) error {
83		return filepath.WalkDir(sessionsRoot, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
84			if err != nil {
85				return nil // skip unreadable entries rather than abort the sweep
86			}
87			if d.IsDir() {
88				if d.Name() == subagentDirName {
89					return filepath.SkipDir
90				}
91				return nil
92			}
93			if d.Name() != sessionFileName {
94				return nil
95			}
96			visit(path)
97			return nil
98		})
99	}
100	
101	// IsSubagentTranscript reports whether a transcript path sits under a subagent
102	// directory. Subagent transcripts share the session format but belong to their
103	// parent session, so every enumeration path filters them out.
104	func IsSubagentTranscript(path string) bool {
105		separator := string(filepath.Separator)
106		return strings.Contains(path, separator+subagentDirName+separator)
107	}
108	
109	// readSessionWorkspaceRoot reads just enough of a transcript to recover the
110	// workspace root recorded in its metadata record. Returns "" when the file
111	// carries no metadata (a transcript truncated before its first record).
112	func readSessionWorkspaceRoot(filePath string) (string, error) {
113		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
116		}
117		defer func() { _ = file.Close() }() // Read-only file; close errors not actionable
118	
119		header := make([]byte, maxHeaderBytes)
120		n, err := io.ReadFull(file, header)
121		if err != nil && err != io.EOF && err != io.ErrUnexpectedEOF {
122			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read session header: %w", err)
123		}
124	
125		// The final line of the prefix is usually cut mid-record; it fails to
126		// unmarshal and is skipped like any other unreadable line.
127		for _, line := range bytes.Split(header[:n], []byte("\n")) {
128			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) == 0 {
129				continue
130			}
131	
132			var record MuseRecord
133			if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &record); err != nil {
134				continue
135			}
136			if record.PayloadType != payloadTypeMetadata {
137				continue
138			}
139	
140			var payload museMetadataPayload
141			if err := json.Unmarshal(record.Payload, &payload); err != nil {
142				continue
143			}
144			if payload.Record.WorkspaceRoot != "" {
145				return payload.Record.WorkspaceRoot, nil
146			}
147		}
148	
149		return "", nil
150	}
151	
152	// findMuseSessions returns the transcripts whose recorded workspace root is the
153	// given project. The store is global and date-sharded rather than project
154	// scoped, so project association can only come from inside each file.
155	// Results are ordered most recent first (the YYYY/MM/DD path sorts
156	// chronologically).
157	func findMuseSessions(projectPath string) ([]museSessionFile, error) {
158		projectPath, err := defaultProjectPath(projectPath)
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162	
163		sessionsRoot, err := GetMuseSessionsDir()
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, err
166		}
167		if _, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot); err != nil {
168			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
169				slog.Debug("findMuseSessions: Muse sessions directory does not exist", "sessionsRoot", sessionsRoot)
170				return nil, nil
171			}
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read Muse sessions directory %q: %w", sessionsRoot, err)
173		}
174	
175		targetRoot := spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(projectPath)
176	
177		var paths []string
178		if err := walkMuseSessionFiles(sessionsRoot, func(path string) {
179			paths = append(paths, path)
180		}); err != nil {
181			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to walk Muse sessions directory: %w", err)
182		}
183	
184		var matches []museSessionFile
185		for _, path := range paths {
186			workspaceRoot, err := readSessionWorkspaceRoot(path)
187			if err != nil {
188				slog.Debug("findMuseSessions: Skipping unreadable transcript", "path", path, "error", err)
189				continue
190			}
191			if workspaceRoot == "" || spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(workspaceRoot) != targetRoot {
192				continue
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, museSessionFile{
195				Path:          path,
196				SessionID:     sessionIDFromPath(path),
197				WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
198			})
199		}
200	
201		// Descending path order is descending date order, so the newest sessions
202		// come first without stat-ing every file.
203		sort.Slice(matches, func(i, j int) bool {
204			return matches[i].Path > matches[j].Path
205		})
206	
207		slog.Debug("findMuseSessions: Completed scan",
208			"sessionsRoot", sessionsRoot,
209			"projectPath", projectPath,
210			"transcripts", len(paths),
211			"matches", len(matches))
212	
213		return matches, nil
214	}
215	
216	// findMuseSessionPathByID locates a session directory by id without reading any
217	// transcript: the store is keyed by session id, so the id is a path component.
218	// Returns "" when no such session exists.
219	func findMuseSessionPathByID(sessionID string) (string, error) {
220		if sessionID == "" {
221			return "", nil
222		}
223	
224		sessionsRoot, err := GetMuseSessionsDir()
225		if err != nil {
226			return "", err
227		}
228	
229		// sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<session-id>/session.jsonl
230		pattern := filepath.Join(sessionsRoot, "*", "*", "*", sessionID, sessionFileName)
231		matches, err := filepath.Glob(pattern)
232		if err != nil {
233			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to search Muse sessions for %q: %w", sessionID, err)
234		}
235		if len(matches) == 0 {
236			return "", nil
237		}
238	
239		// A session id is unique; more than one match means the same id was
240		// re-shared across days, so take the most recent.
241		sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(matches)))
242		return matches[0], nil
243	}
244

// store, regardless of project. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
//
// Muse's store is global and date-sharded, so the project association comes
// from the workspace_root recorded inside each transcript rather than from the
// path.
func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
	return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
}

// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all sessions while reporting
// scan progress into r (nil-safe). Used by `specstory reindex`.
func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
	sessionsRoot, err := GetMuseSessionsDir()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot); err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return []spi.GlobalSessionRef{}, nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read Muse sessions directory: %w", err)
	}

	return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(sessionsRoot, "muse", r, func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
		// Only top-level <session-id>/session.jsonl files are sessions;
		// subagent transcripts belong to their parent.
		if filepath.Base(path) != sessionFileName || IsSubagentTranscript(path) {
			return nil, nil
		}

		session, err := ParseSessionFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		metadata := extractMuseSessionMetadata(session)
		if metadata == nil {
			return nil, nil // telemetry-only or prompt-less session
		}

		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
			SessionID:  metadata.SessionID,
			CreatedAt:  metadata.CreatedAt,
			Slug:       metadata.Slug,
			Name:       metadata.Name,
			NativePath: path,
			OriginCwd:  session.WorkspaceRoot,
		}, nil
	})
}

**Cause 1 — the test helper corrupts the fixture JSON on Windows (8 of the 9 failures).**

`writeSession` (`path_utils_test.go:42`) rewrites the fixture's neutral workspace root by raw string substitution:

```go

```

So the metadata record never parses, `readSessionWorkspaceRoot` returns `""`, no session matches the project, and everything downstream reports `count = 0` / `OriginCwd = ""`. This is purely a test bug — real Muse transcripts on Windows would contain properly escaped `C:\\Users\\...`.

One wrinkle: `session-tools.jsonl` also carries the root inside a *doubly*-encoded JSON string (`\"workdir\": \"/Users/dev/project\"`), so a fix must escape that occurrence twice or that inner payload breaks instead.

**Cause 2 — `IsSubagentTranscript` is separator-native, the test isn't.**

Production callers pass native paths (WalkDir results, fsnotify events), so this is not currently a live bug — but Windows also accepts forward slashes, so the function is fragile.

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

const fixtureRoot = "/Users/dev/project"

func esc(s string) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	return string(b[1 : len(b)-1])
}

// walk parses any nested JSON-in-string values, mirroring what the tool-arg
// renderer does.
func walk(v any, found *int, path string) error {
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, vv := range t {
			if err := walk(vv, found, path+"."+k); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, vv := range t {
			if err := walk(vv, found, path+"[]"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case string:
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(t)
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "{") {
			var inner any
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &inner); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("nested JSON at %s failed: %w", path, err)
			}
			*found++
			return walk(inner, found, path+"(nested)")
		}
		if strings.Contains(t, "RUNNER~1") {
			fmt.Printf("  value at %s = %q\n", path, t)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	win := `C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\TestX2752140291\002`
	escaped := esc(win)
	nested := esc(escaped)

	for _, f := range os.Args[1:] {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(f)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		content := strings.ReplaceAll(string(data), `\"`+fixtureRoot+`\"`, `\"`+nested+`\"`)
		content = strings.ReplaceAll(content, fixtureRoot, escaped)

		fmt.Printf("== %s\n", f)
		nestedCount := 0
		for i, line := range strings.Split(content, "\n") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
				continue
			}
			var rec any
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &rec); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("  line %d: OUTER UNMARSHAL FAILED: %v\n", i+1, err)
				continue
			}
			if err := walk(rec, &nestedCount, fmt.Sprintf("line%d", i+1)); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("  line %d: %v\n", i+1, err)
			}
		}
		fmt.Printf("  nested JSON payloads parsed: %d\n", nestedCount)
	}
}
EOF
